description: See every Claude Code, Codex and Qwen Code session you ran outside BB, under the titles the agents gave them. The new-thread screen lists the sessions from the selected project's folders, and a Sessions page lists all of them with agent filters and search. Open any session to read its transcript, show its tool calls, or copy the command that resumes it in a terminal. Session files are read on the machine that runs BB and are never uploaded or changed.
